description.en: Make a short animated video that announces one of your upcoming events, ready to post as an Instagram story (vertical) or a portrait post. Pick the event from one list that gathers your streams and, when they are set up, your scheduled YouTube videos and your Twitch schedule, sorted by date and time. Then pick a style, what it shows, your own sentence and the length; it is made right in your browser and downloaded as a file.
description.fr: Fabriquez une petite vidéo animée qui annonce l'un de vos prochains événements, prête à publier en story Instagram (vertical) ou en publication portrait. Choisissez l'événement dans une seule liste qui rassemble vos streams et, s'ils sont réglés, vos vidéos YouTube programmées et votre planning Twitch, triés par date et heure. Choisissez ensuite un style, ce qu'elle montre, votre propre phrase et sa durée : elle se fabrique dans votre navigateur et se télécharge comme un fichier.

privacy.en: Nothing is collected about your visitors, and there is no public page. The module keeps your saved models (only the Contacts card number of each guest streamer), a short list of one-off people, a yes/no for the “Made with Curiosa” mark and, for 7 days at most, what an assistant prepared (with the chosen event's identifier). Upcoming events are read live and held in memory for under a minute. Names and pictures stay in Contacts. No video is kept: it is made in your browser.
privacy.fr: Rien n'est collecté sur vos visiteurs, et il n'y a pas de page publique. Le module garde vos modèles (pour chaque co-streamer, seulement le numéro de sa fiche dans Contacts), une courte liste de ponctuels, un oui/non pour la mention « Made with Curiosa » et, 7 jours au plus, ce qu'un assistant a préparé (avec l'identifiant de l'événement choisi). Les événements à venir sont lus en direct et gardés en mémoire moins d'une minute. Les noms et photos restent dans Contacts. Aucune vidéo n'est gardée (elle se fait dans votre navigateur).

mcp.name: story_models
mcp.description: The video models the owner saved for the announcement story (a model = a style, a format, a length, the elements to show, a sentence and guest streamers (people from the owner's Contacts, or typed in for one video), saved under a name). Use it before story_prepare to reuse a model by its name. Read only.

mcp.name: story_next_streams
mcp.description: The next streams found in the owner's calendar (up to 8): a 'key' (to give to story_prepare), the title, the start (UTC, ISO 8601), whether it is a whole-day event, the games and the time zone when known. 'state' is 'ok', 'empty' (no calendar installed, or nothing planned) or 'slow' (the calendar did not answer in time). Calendar only: for every kind of upcoming event (scheduled YouTube videos, Twitch schedule…) use story_events. Read only.

mcp.name: story_events
mcp.description: The upcoming events the owner can make a story for, from ALL active sources (the calendar, scheduled YouTube videos and premieres, the Twitch schedule…), merged, without duplicates, sorted by date and time. Each event has a stable 'id' (to give to story_prepare as 'event'), title, start (UTC, ISO 8601), whole-day flag, time zone when known, type (stream, live, premiere, video, event), source and link. Pages of up to 50 ('next' is the cursor for the following page, at most 200 events in all); 'q' searches the titles and games; 'source' keeps one source. 'sources' says which sources answered ('ok'), need setting up ('setup') or did not answer ('down'). 'state' is 'ok', 'empty' (nothing planned) or 'slow' (no source answered). Read only.

q.description: Words to look for in the titles, games and source names.

source.description: Keep one source only: the 'source' value of an event (for example calendar, youtube, twitch).

cursor.description: The 'next' value of the previous page.

mcp.name: story_prepare
mcp.description: Prepares an announcement story video for the owner and returns a LINK to the admin page with everything already filled in. Nothing is generated or published: the owner opens the link while signed in, checks the animated preview, clicks 'Generate the video' and saves the file (the video can only be made in a browser). Start from a saved model (story_models) and/or give settings. The event is chosen with 'event' (an id from story_events, any source), or the stream with 'stream' ('next' by default, or a key from story_next_streams), or hand-written (streamTitle + streamDate [+ streamTime]); give only one of the three. Writes only a preparation that expires after 7 days. All values are checked; an invalid one is refused with an explanation.

model.description: Name of a saved model to start from (see story_models).

style.description: neon = glitching neon text; poster = film-poster slide-in; countdown = big rolling numbers; minimal = plain background, letters typed one by one.

durationSeconds.description: Length of the video in seconds (5 to 15, default 15).

elements.description: What to show, taken from: title, when, countdown, game, brand, text, costreamers. Default: all of them.

text.description: Optional custom sentence (up to 140 characters, up to 3 lines). Plain text only.

channelName.description: Optional name shown next to the logo (default: the site name).

language.description: Language of the words written in the video (dates and countdown).

stream.description: 'next' (default) or a key given by story_next_streams.

event.description: An event id given by story_events (any source). Use instead of 'stream'.

streamTitle.description: Hand-written stream: its title (use instead of 'stream').

streamDate.description: Hand-written stream: the day, written YYYY-MM-DD.

streamTime.description: Hand-written stream: the start time, written HH:MM (24 h). Leave out for a whole day.

costreamers.description: Up to 6 Twitch names (4 to 25 letters, digits or _) of guest streamers to show. A name that matches a person in the owner's Contacts is linked to that card (name and picture come from Contacts); any other name is shown for this video only.

watermark.description: Optional. true = add a small 'Made with Curiosa' mark at the bottom of the video; false = none. Default: the owner's own choice (off unless she chose otherwise). Never add it unless the owner asked for it.
